subject: general
question: Three points P, Q, R, and S are located on the circumference of a circle. If ∠RPS = 30° and ∠PQS = 40°, what is the measure of ∠PRS?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angles subtended by the same arc at any point on the remaining part of the circle are always equal.

Here, the arc PS subtends ∠PQS and ∠PRS at the circumference.

∴ ∠PRS = ∠PQS.

Given ∠PQS = 40°, we directly get ∠PRS = 40° (The given ∠RPS = 30° is redundant information).

**∴ The correct answer is 40°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠RPS = 30°

∠PQS = 40°

**Concept Used:**

Angles in the same segment of a circle
